en-US.longDescription: AxMath is an interactive WYSIWYG equation editor. It is designed with love, passion and expertise. It has all kinds of functionalities which make you type equations at lightspeed. Key features include semantic math input, auto calculation, LaTeX conversion, memory board, etc.
en-US.name: AxMath

zh-CN.description: 专业的公式编辑器及计算器
zh-CN.longDescription: AxMath 是一款专业的公式编辑器及科学计算软件，集公式编辑、排版及科学计算于一身。支持 OLE 嵌入，可与 Microsoft Office / WPS 等常见文档编辑软件协同操作，还可以矢量输出或输出为图片格式。
zh-CN.name: AxMath
